stem.text: Tetanus is an infectious disease caused by a type of bacterium. This bacterium produces a protein that is a toxin which causes illness.
Scientists have produced a vaccine for tetanus which contains a harmless form of the toxin called a toxoid.
The toxoid is produced by mixing the toxin with the chemical formaldehyde. This chemical binds to the toxin making it harmless.
Which statement about the tetanus vaccine is correct?

A.text: After vaccination, the toxoid in the vaccine will be ingested by neutrophils and displayed in their cell surface membranes.

B.text: The tetanus vaccine containing the toxoid **does not** contain antigens because it **does not** contain any cells of the pathogen.

C.text: The toxoid protein in the vaccine stimulates the production of antibodies which remain in the blood to provide long-term immunity.

D.text: When formaldehyde binds to the toxin, it causes the toxin to completely change shape.
